title: betula mandshurica var. szechuanica
intro: Betula mandshurica var. szechuanica, commonly known as Chinese birch or Szechuan birch, is a plant species within the Betula genus, belonging to the family Betulaceae. This plant is used in traditional Chinese medicine, where it is valued for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and diuretic properties. The therapeutic actions of Betula mandshurica var. szechuanica include its ability to relieve fever, reduce edema, and treat conditions such as arthritis and gout. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
